0022600018.text: The 76ers (4-1, 2-1 at home, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East) host the Knicks (2-3, 8th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic and 2 games back) as they look to build on a one-game winning streak, while New York is riding a two-game streak of its own. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), all out, and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 106-100 in New York on October 20, the 2025-26 series was split 2-2, and the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
